O: a marking of the room's work as up or achieved comes first and a record of what happened to that work follows it, so {el}'s order is shown; a specification
M: a marking is answered by a record asked for, saved or given (the final image, a timelapse, what changed), or one post marks the work and then keeps it, so the order is shown in the members' words (the mechanism in words, which the census counts apart); a specification
J: the room's first marking is itself a record of what happened to the work (its fate, the work said to have lasted, or a final image posted as done; G16 and G13), so the first act of each is one act and {el}'s order cannot be read; the census counts it apart
JM: the room's first marking is itself a record of what happened to the work, so the first act of each is one act and {el}'s order cannot be read, though a record is asked for or given after it; the census counts it apart as joint
ONE: only one end is shown: a record with no marking of the room's own work, or a marking with no record; {el}'s order is not shown
OTHER: the marking and the record are of another room's work, which the room's members do not build or keep with them (the visitor rule); {el}'s order is not shown in the room's own work
P-G6: the line is marked NONPORTABLE and fails portability, a particular (G6)
